many_crossing_checks.status: exact parameter, envelope, and comparison-bound certificate
many_crossing_checks.graph: Binary de Bruijn graph on L-letter states. Use cycles of 1^k 0^(L-k) and their complements, sharing the central cycle. Put the displayed weight on one distinguished edge per noncentral cycle, and 1 on its other edges. Add epsilon to the base weight of every de Bruijn edge. Tilt by the first bit of the current state.
